meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: Claude 会分步引导你：先确认目标聊天频道和你的身份，再创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体，并通过正常发信路径给你发一条欢迎私信，然后等你确认收到。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行时，你要求 Claude 为某个聊天频道创建第一个智能体并让它发欢迎私信，就会进入此流程。

say.text: 我要在 Slack 里建第一个智能体，让它给我发一条 DM。
say.note: 会引导你完成频道选择和身份填写。

howto.what_en: Claude walks the operator step by step through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: it asks which channel to use, collects the operator's identity, runs the initialization script, sends a welcome DM via the normal delivery path, and waits for confirmation.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the operator asks Claude to create the first agent for a chat channel and trigger a welcome DM, and only after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

say_en.text: Set up the first NanoClaw agent on Telegram and send me a welcome DM.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm your identity and run the init flow.

say_en.text: Create the first agent in Slack and have it DM me a welcome message.
say_en.note: Claude walks you through channel and identity setup.

say_en.text: Run init-first-agent for Discord and send the welcome DM to me.
say_en.note: This starts the first-agent initialization flow.
